-c "import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,zipfile,io,pathlib,shutil; tag='v0.1.0-alpha.2'; url='https://api.github.com/repos/hexonMD/moon-sweepers-dedicated-server/releases/tags/'+tag; req=lambda u: urllib.request.Request(u,headers={'User-Agent':'AMP-MoonSweepers-Updater','Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'}); release=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req(url),timeout=30)); assets=[a for a in release['assets'] if a['name'].lower().endswith('.zip')]; assert len(assets)==1, 'Expected exactly one release ZIP, found: '+str([a['name'] for a in assets]); payload=urllib.request.urlopen(req(assets[0]['browser_download_url']),timeout=120).read(); z=zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(payload)); matches=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.lower().endswith('/version.dll') or n.lower()=='version.dll']; assert len(matches)==1, 'Expected one version.dll, found: '+str(matches); data=z.read(matches[0]); assert data[:2]==b'MZ', 'version.dll is not a Windows PE binary'; dest=pathlib.Path('{{$FullBaseDir}}')/'serverfiles/mod/version.dll'; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); shutil.copy2(dest,dest.with_suffix('.dll.previous')) if dest.exists() else None; dest.write_bytes(data); print('Installed '+str(dest)+' ('+str(len(data))+' bytes) from '+assets[0]['name'])"

-c "echo '========== MOON SWEEPERS DIAGNOSTICS =========='; echo '[1] Required commands'; for c in wine wine64 wineserver Xvfb xdpyinfo python3 curl unzip; do if command -v \"$c\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"[OK] $c: $(command -v \"$c\")\"; else echo \"[MISSING] $c\"; fi; done; echo '[2] Wine executable'; if test -x /usr/lib/wine/wine64; then echo '[OK] /usr/lib/wine/wine64'; else echo '[MISSING] /usr/lib/wine/wine64'; fi; echo '[3] Server files'; for f in serverfiles/bin/entrypoint serverfiles/bin/server-import serverfiles/bin/steam-redist serverfiles/bin/health.py serverfiles/mod/version.dll gamefiles/MoonSweepers.exe gamefiles/GameAssembly.dll gamefiles/UnityPlayer.dll serverfiles/game/MoonSweepers.exe; do if test -f \"{{$FullBaseDir}}$f\"; then echo \"[OK] $f\"; else echo \"[MISSING] $f\"; fi; done; echo '[4] Writable directories'; for d in serverfiles serverfiles/game serverfiles/wineprefix serverfiles/logs; do p=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}$d\"; if test -d \"$p\"; then if test -w \"$p\"; then echo \"[OK] $d writable\"; else echo \"[FAIL] $d not writable\"; fi; else echo \"[MISSING] $d\"; fi; done; echo '[5] Environment'; for v in DISPLAY WINEPREFIX WINEARCH WINEDLLOVERRIDES MOON_SLOT MOON_GAME_PORT MOON_QUERY_PORT MOON_BACKUP_KEEP; do if test -n \"${!v:-}\"; then echo \"[OK] $v is set\"; else echo \"[MISSING] $v\"; fi; done; echo '[6] Runtime commands referenced in entrypoint'; grep -nE 'wine64|Xvfb|xdpyinfo|/opt/moon|/import/game|/data' \"{{$FullBaseDir}}serverfiles/bin/entrypoint\" | tail -30 || true; echo '========== DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE =========='"
